        ### Question
        Question linked to image no. 30 A 7-year-old girl is admitted to the hospital for presenting a 72-hour history of fever of up to 38.5ºC, malaise and difficulty swallowing. The examination shows a generalized skin rash whose characteristics can be seen in the image. What is the most likely diagnosis?

opb. Stevens-Johnson syndrome.
